text:
andrew: Quick draft of internal release note and announce timing — making this the pinned post for tomorrow's deployment window. TL;DR: small infra change (gRPC connection pooling fix), model pin bump v3.2.1 -> v3.2.2 with fallback to v3.1.9, canary 5%. Copy below, pls review. @lola can you confirm pin + publish time? :eyes:

andrew: DRAFT RN snippet:

Internal release (2026-03-25): gRPC connection pooling fix
- Impact: reduces connection churn for long-lived inference streams, lowers p99 spikes
- Action for apps: no action required; model will be pinned to v3.2.2 during rollout.
- Rollback: automatic fallback to v3.1.9 if latency regression > 10% or error rate > 1%

Deploybot command (will run canary cohorts):
```
/deploy release-2026-03-25 --pin v3.2.2 --canary 5% --cohorts internal,staging,prod
```

maya: LGTM. One Q: is any quantization or model profile changing? We should call that out for Dedicated customers.

andrew: No quantization changes, just runtime pooling + KV cache warmup for prefixes. I'll add a short note for Dedicated.

jen: Oncall heads-up — please set a hard change window. Recommend 02:00-02:30 UTC with 30m monitoring after canary. Rollback trigger (manual):
```
/deploy rollback release-2026-03-25 --to v3.1.9
```
Oncall, can you confirm standby? @maya can you assign?

sam: Copy tweak: change "no action required" -> "no action required unless you run long streaming sessions; contact infra-help if you observe errors". Makes it clearer.

lola: Confirmed — I will pin the RN and schedule internal blast at 01:45 UTC. Will ping oncall 15m before. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Deploybot queued: release-2026-03-25 scheduled by andrew at 1729609999. Canary: 5%. Cohorts: internal, staging, 5% prod.

jen: Also add these dashboards/alerts to the runbook: p99 latency, connection errors/sec, token throughput. Suggested dash: https://redwood.monitor/dash/release-2026-03-25

maya: Ack. I'll update the Dedicated customer notice and attach to the internal RN.

andrew: Thanks everyone — I'll incorporate edits and post final copy here, then @lola can publish. Planning to trigger canary at 02:05 UTC if all green.
